jobs_results.title: Data Analyst III
jobs_results.description:
About the Company: 

 Ruder Finn is seeking a Senior Data Analyst (Data Analyst III) to join its award-winning Emerging Technology & Analytics team. The chosen candidate will support the agency’s new business efforts by spearheading the research activities such as but not limited to earned media analysis, social listening, influencer identification, data modeling and predictive analytics. This individual will collaborate with several account teams within the agency providing counsel as needed on the various research and analytics needs of the agency’s clients. As Data Analyst III, you will have the opportunity to work alongside the Chief Technology Officer based in New York, NY, on several innovative Consumer, Technology, and Healthcare-related client accounts. The ideal candidate would be a digital native with deep expertise in and a passion for data visualization and storytelling, statistics, web analytics, social media analytics, and the ability to connect the dots back to business objectives. 



 This position will be fully remote, and the working hours will be either 6:00 pm – 3:30 am IST / 8:30 am – 6:00 pm ET  or 2:00 pm – 11:00 pm IST / 4:30 am – 1:30 pm ET  . 



 Ultimately, your work will help define the business strategy for projects and clients and play a significant role in the growth of the agency. 



 About the Role: 

 If you are motivated by complex, purposeful challenges, this role, with one of the world's largest independent PR and Comms agencies, could be the fit you have been looking for!



 Job Responsibilities: 



 Collaborate with the global Emerging Technology & Analytics team colleagues in research projects pertaining to new business or client mandates involving sourcing, analysis, and reporting of data and insights tied to the concerned business objectives  Deliver market and audience intelligence, including social and digital landscape analysis, audience behavior analysis, sentiment analysis, keyword research, search performance, and competitor analysis including but not limited to share of voice and message pull through  Build measurement frameworks, set up searches and dashboards using Boolean queries, and develop client-facing insights and reports 

 Qualifications: 



 Bachelor's Degree in business analytics, computer science, marketing, psychology, or advertising preferred  A minimum of 4 years of agency or in-house experience in a data or research analyst role  Experience and expertise with writing complex Boolean queries and operating data and media analytics tools such as Cision, Brandwatch, Rival IQ, Meltwater, Signal AI, etc.  Expertise in Excel, Google Sheets, Google Analytics and one or more contemporary data visualization platforms (e.g.: Tableau, Power BI, Google Data Studio, etc.) along with SQL  Proficiency in AWS, Python, R, and any other statistical computing or functional programming language is a major plus  Experience with data modeling and developing custom models is a plus  Experience with custom LLMs and working with the contemporary LLMs (e.g. ChatGPT, Bard, etc.) is a plus  Excellent problem-solving, creative thinking, general modeling, and data processing skills  Strong project management skills, self-starter, ability to adapt and multi-task, and a proven track record of delivering quality and accurate results in a fast-paced and high efficiency agency environment  Extremely strong verbal and written English language communication skills

Employment type: Third Party

The role will be responsible for KPI reporting, marketing analytics, NPS analysis, web journey analysis, and executive dashboards.

•    Marketing analytics and campaign measurement
•    Website journey, funnel and conversion analysis

•    Reporting automation and self-service analytics
•    Data quality and governance
•    Agentic AI workflow creation & implementation
•    Executive presentations

jobs_results.description:
Job Description
  
  


  
   
     About Persistent


    


    

      We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.


    


    

      Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026.


    


    

       About Position:


    


    

      We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Analyst with strong expertise in SQL, Azure, and Data Analytics to support enterprise data initiatives and drive data-driven decision-making. The ideal candidate will be responsible for analyzing complex datasets, identifying business insights, optimizing analytical models, and supporting strategic transformation programs within Banking and Financial Services environments. The role requires strong experience in Data Warehousing, Data Lakes, Azure technologies, and stakeholder collaboration to deliver high-quality analytical solutions.


    


    
     

        Role: Senior Data Analyst - SQL & Azure
      Location: Mumbai
      Experience: 5 to 9 Years
      Job Type: Full-Time Employment
    
    


    

       What You'll Do:


    

    


    
     Analyze large volumes of structured and unstructured data to uncover actionable business insights.
     Lead data analysis activities and support business transformation and strategic initiatives.
     Develop, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and analytical datasets.
     Perform data profiling, reconciliation, validation, and quality assessments.
     Work with Data Lakes, Data Warehouses, and cloud-based analytical platforms.
     Design and enhance analytical models to support reporting and business intelligence requirements.
     Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into analytical solutions.
     Partner with QA, Platform, Engineering, and DevOps teams for successful solution delivery.
     Support dashboarding, reporting, and ad-hoc analysis requests.
     Participate in data architecture discussions and contribute to data strategy initiatives.
     Identify trends, patterns, and opportunities through advanced data analysis techniques.
     Present findings, recommendations, and business insights to stakeholders and leadership teams.
     Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and compliance with organizational standards.
    
    


    

       Expertise You'll Bring:


    

    


    
     5 to 9 years of experience in Data Analysis, Business Intelligence, or Analytics roles.
     Strong expertise in SQL development, query optimization, and stored procedure analysis.
     Hands-on experience with Azure Data Services, Databricks, Azure Synapse, or similar cloud technologies.
     Experience working with Data Lake, Data Warehouse, and enterprise data platforms.
     Strong understanding of OLTP systems, Data Warehouse concepts, and dimensional data models.
     Experience leading or contributing significantly to enterprise data analytics projects.
     Knowledge of Data Architecture, Data Modeling, and Analytical Frameworks.
     Strong understanding of RDBMS concepts, data structures, and analytical algorithms.
     Experience creating reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
     Ability to analyze complex datasets and convert findings into meaningful business recommendations.
     Experience working with cross-functional teams including QA, Platform Delivery, Engineering, and DevOps.
     Strong problem-solving, analytical thinking, and decision-making abilities.
     Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
     Experience working within Banking or Financial Services environments is highly preferred.
    
    


    

       Benefits:


    

    


    
     Competitive salary and benefits package
     Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
     Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
     Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
     Annual health check-ups
     Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents
    
    


    

       Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:



    


    Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.


    

    


    
     We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
     Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
     If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment
    
    


    

       Let's unleash your full potential at Persistent - persistent.com/careers

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst Intern (Marketing)
jobs_results.description:
Role Description The Data Analyst Intern (Marketing) role is a full-time on-site position based in Navi Mumbai. The intern will support the marketing team by collecting, cleaning, and analyzing campaign and user data from various digital channels.


Day-to-day tasks include preparing dashboards and reports, identifying trends and patterns in performance metrics, and assisting in building data-driven recommendations to optimize campaigns and improve ROI. The role also involves collaborating with marketers and designers to translate insights into actionable strategies and testing hypotheses through A/B experiments. This position offers hands-on exposure to marketing analytics tools, performance marketing workflows, and real-world business decision-making.


Qualifications

Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret quantitative data and identify meaningful trends.
Foundational knowledge of data analytics and data modeling for marketing or business use cases.
Basic understanding of statistics, including descriptive statistics and hypothesis testing.
Effective communication skills to present insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Familiarity with Excel/Google Sheets; exposure to analytics or BI tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Power BI, Tableau) is a plus.
Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Marketing, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
Ability to work on-site in Navi Mumbai and collaborate in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
Curiosity, attention to detail, and a strong interest in performance marketing and ROI optimization.
